import math
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    x = int(data[0])
    y = int(data[1])
    n = int(data[2])
    
    INF = float('inf')
    min_diff = INF
    ans_a = 0
    ans_b = 0
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        a = (x * i) // y
        diff1 = abs(x / y - a / i)
        if min_diff > diff1:
            min_diff = diff1
            ans_a = a
            ans_b = i
        
        a += 1
        diff2 = abs(x / y - a / i)
        if min_diff > diff2:
            min_diff = diff2
            ans_a = a
            ans_b = i
    
    print(f"{ans_a}/{ans_b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
